# Instilligent Limited

> New Zealand software company building AI products for regulated industries across New Zealand, Australia, and Southeast Asia.

## About

Instilligent is a New Zealand-based software company founded in 2015 by Marc Armstrong. We build AI software for regulated industries — compliance registers, trade health-and-safety tools, maritime safety systems, and related products. With over 15 years of experience in software delivery, systems integration, and technology, we operate across New Zealand, Australia, and Southeast Asia.

We build production-grade AI software that solves real business problems. Our products are described only by what they actually do today.

## Products

- [Modular Compliance](https://modularcompliance.com) — Live. NZ-built compliance register and workflow tool. Maps legislation into frameworks, controls and tasks, records who completed what and when, and stores supporting evidence — people do the compliance work, the tool keeps the record. Does not connect to operational systems, monitor transactions, screen activity, or take regulatory action.
- [BossBoard](https://bossboard.instilligent.com) — Health & safety compliance for NZ tradespeople. Manage site diaries, incident reports, SWMS, and subcontractor records. Free during beta • Paid tiers from NZD 4.99/week at launch.
- [Mastering MOSS](https://masteringmoss.co.nz) — Maritime Operator Safety System (MOSS) for NZ commercial maritime operators. Digital MTOP/MTOC document builder, vessel + crew registry, compliance checklists, maintenance and safety equipment tracking. From NZD 29/month. Live.
- [Instilligent Courses](https://courses.instilligent.com) — AI practice exams and structured courses for NZ professionals.
- [CodeHumanist](https://codehumanist.com) — Read-only codebase comprehension platform for human stakeholders. Understand AI-generated codebases — architecture, data flows, use cases — without touching code. Currently waitlist.
- [ProofOnce](https://proofonce.com) — Planned document and identity verification product. Verify once, reuse across consumers. Coming Soon / pre-launch.

## Technology

We build with Anthropic Claude, MCP Protocol, Claude Code, Python, React, Next.js, Docker, Cloudflare, and Railway.
